list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18. Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own; every guide below is written for this project, in our own words, and cites its sources.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — there is nothing extra to do for it. It needs no multiplayer and no DLC, since every trophy in the list is single-player. Treat it as your finish line: the roadmap orders the other 54 so the platinum arrives naturally at the end. PowerPyx rates the whole run about 200 hours at 4/10 difficulty.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and this unlocks as the story gets going. It is unmissable — just play through the introduction as Lucia and Jason's story opens in Leonida. Expect it within your first hour or so with the game.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Chapters unlock in order, so keep playing the story missions marked on your map; there is no way to skip a chapter. This is the first of five chapters, and PowerPyx puts the full story at roughly 60 to 80 hours.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Like every chapter trophy it unlocks automatically when the chapter's final mission ends. If you are hunting the one missable trophy, make sure you meditate at Jason's house during Chapter 1 before this chapter closes — after that the moment is gone.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Keep following the story missions; the trophy pops when the chapter wraps up. By now Vice City is open to explore, which is a good time to start scanning vehicles and studying animals — both feed the 100% checklist later.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. This is the second-to-last chapter trophy, earned by finishing the chapter's final mission. You are nearly at the end of the five-chapter story, and free roam after the credits keeps everything else available.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. This is the story finale — finish the last mission of Chapter 5 and the gold pops with the credits. After the credits the game returns you to free roam, so everything you have not finished yet stays available.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story missions unlock in order, so play through the chapter until this one appears and finish it. The trophy is tied to that single mission, but story trophies unlock automatically — there is no way to fail it for good.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story heist mission — follow the mission markers until it appears, then play it through. Heists in GTA VI are set-piece missions, so expect a longer, multi-stage job with a big payoff.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Another named story mission; it unlocks as you progress the chapters. Just keep playing the main story and it will come — no side requirement, no special approach.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story mission trophy — finish Headliners when the story offers it. The name itself is a spoiler, which is why the spoiler setting in this guide hides it until you earn it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Play through the story until this mission appears at the airport and finish it. VCIA is Vice City International Airport, so expect vehicles, runways and a loud exit.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. The last of the named-mission trophies; finish the operation when the story hands it to you. With this, every story-mission trophy is yours except the finale.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. After the credits, check Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion for the checklist. PowerPyx reports the bar is lenient — closer to 60% of true completion: about 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, and 70 of the 80 challenges, so you can skip the hardest ones. Work through the checklist after the story; most of it fills in naturally while you chase the other trophies.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts include stunt jumps, flying under bridges, knife flights and base jumps — PowerPyx counts 397 stunt opportunities across Leonida, and the 100% checklist needs 300. Mix them up as you travel: jump ramps in cars, thread bridges in planes, and leap from high places with a parachute. The counter ticks up in free roam, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The game tracks 9 activity types — dip into each one at least once rather than mastering any. Use the activities menu or the map icons to find one you have not tried yet; a single attempt at each is enough.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 range challenges, and every one needs gold. Practice the range scoring — steady aim and controlled bursts beat spraying — and replay a challenge until the gold medal lands. This is a pure skill trophy: no shortcut, just repetition.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 drone race locations across Leonida. Win one race at each — you do not need to win every race, just one per location. Learn each course's turns on a practice run, then race clean and cut the corners where the course allows.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count — street races, drone races and other race types all feed the total. Winning the same race twice does not count twice, so keep moving to new events on the map instead of farming one favourite.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges appear as you explore Leonida's waters — take Cal on and out-fish him. Watch the line tension and reel steadily; the challenge is about patience and timing, not power.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet in Leonida, pick a game and play it through to the end. Any arcade game counts, so choose the one you enjoy most and finish a full run.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of the side characters with a mission strand — work through his jobs until his last one appears and finish it. Side strands are available in free roam after the story, so nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's strand of side missions to unlock his finale. Like the other character strands, it stays available after the story ends, so do it whenever you like.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Play through Billy's side missions until his final job unlocks. Stranger and side strands are free-roam content — check the map for his icon between story chapters or after the credits.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons around the map — finish 8 full strands, not just 8 missions. PowerPyx notes it is still confirming exactly which questlines count, so keep a save from before you finish your eighth strand if you want to be safe. This trophy is not part of the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's side strand through to its last mission. Randy's jobs are scattered across Leonida, so check the map for his icon between story chapters.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Play Tyrone's strand to its conclusion. Side-character finales like this one are all available in free roam after the credits, so there is no deadline.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots in 10 locations. THE MISSABLE ONE: PowerPyx reports the first meditation, offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1, can be lost permanently if you leave the chapter without doing it — the game's only potentially missable trophy, because there is no mission replay. Meditate the moment the game offers it in Chapter 1, then find the remaining spots as you explore.
trophies.missableNote: Potentially missable: the first meditation spot, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, can be lost if you finish the chapter without meditating there. Do it the moment it is offered.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand involves hunting — track down the unique animal he asks for and take it down. Use binoculars to study animals first; that also feeds the 100% checklist's animal count, which needs 100 of 255 studied.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — collect full sets, and three complete sets pop the trophy. Check your collection menu to see which sets are nearly done, then hunt the missing cards in those sets first instead of grabbing cards at random.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-world photo and sharing app — use it at 100 different spots. Fold this into exploration: snap a WAiNK shot whenever you reach a new area and the count climbs on its own while you chase the other trophies.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges in total and you only need 50, so skip the ones you hate. Challenges cover driving, shooting, flying and more — pick the easy half first, then fill in from the 100% checklist, which needs 70 of the 80.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to four stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Wide open countryside and the water work well — lose the helicopters first, then wait out the search in cover.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole time — do not let it drop to zero between robberies, and do not let it spike out of control either. Plan a route with three close shops and a fast getaway car parked nearby.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Simply get into 100 different vehicles — scanning them with the in-game tool counts toward the 100% checklist too, which needs 200 of 277 scanned. Variety is the point: cars, bikes, boats, planes and anything else with an engine.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aiming mode — trigger it with a group of enemies in front of you and drop five before it ends. Pick a spot where enemies cluster, such as a gang shootout, and use a weapon with a big magazine.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, leave in a way the airport did not schedule — grab a plane and take off without following the rules. Expect a wanted level; the trophy is the exit itself, so do not bother landing neatly.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the military tanks — get into trouble with them, or take one on. Pick a fight near a military area and deal with the tank that shows up; heavy weapons and distance help, and a stolen tank of your own is the fastest answer.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan the approach: go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again — the trophy only counts a clean run.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five separate bank vault robberies, each followed by a clean escape. Plan each one like a heist: know the exit before you go in, have a fast car waiting, and do not linger once the vault is open.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and get away before the police close in. Trucks spawn around the city — follow one until the road is quiet, then strike and vanish.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. There are 52 areas to discover — the map fog clears as you visit each one. Flying over the dark patches is the fastest way to fill the map in, according to early guides. The 100% checklist tracks this too, so it doubles as progress toward A Long Road.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs in Leonida — rob one illegal operation for each of them. Learn which gang controls which turf, hit their operation, and move on to the next gang's ground. Your map and the locals will tell you who runs where.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view of the water, and order a cocktail. A quiet one — take a moment between jobs and watch the ocean; the trophy pops once the drink and the view come together.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Get into a showroom and drive straight out through the glass, GTA-style. Any showroom works; pick your car, aim for the front, and floor it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and finish a game. It is a gentle one — no skill check, just play a full game through and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one is tied to a partnership moment between the two leads — play the story and the side content with your partner and it will come. Early guides have not pinned down the exact trigger, so keep playing naturally and check the linked guides as the community confirms it.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count up to 500 for this one — it seems to count choices you make across the game. Play through the story making decisions when they are offered; the trophy appears once you have made enough of them.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail at something, then succeed on the second try — the description hints at a retry. If a mission or challenge goes wrong, try it again right away instead of reloading an old save.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange is out there in Leonida — witness it. Early guides list this one as not yet pinned down; explore the odd corners of the map, from the swamps to the back roads, and keep an eye out for the unexplained.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Line up a slow drive-by with a bat or similar weapon and swing as you pass — low speed and a straight line help; a crowded sidewalk is not the place to practice.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. It adds up across the game, so keep laundering as you earn instead of letting bills pile up.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food and anything else across Leonida's shops until $100,000 is spent in total. It counts across all shops, so normal play plus a shopping spree will get you there — weapons and clothes are the fastest sink.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 garage properties to buy around Leonida. Save up, then buy them one by one — each gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you are collecting for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find 10 vehicles and register each one in the Scooter Bros app on your in-game phone. Any vehicles count, so register the ones you drive most — it is a quick job once the app is available.
trophies.name: On the Spot
